items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that keeps sensitive, oily-leaning skin comfortable while you start.
A light mattifying gel moisturizer with 4% niacinamide to help balance shine and support a smoother-looking surface without heaviness.
A mineral SPF 50 is a gentle daily choice for fair, sensitive skin and protects the look of your skin tone and texture.

response.routine_note: I've left out the 30% peel because it is a very strong at-home exfoliant and a harsh first step for skin that scans as sensitive with some redness; start with this simple routine (cleanser and moisturizer morning and night, SPF every morning) for a few weeks. If you still want a smoother look after that, a mild exfoliant can be added once or twice a week.
